title: The Log-span conjecture
statement:
Let $V$ be a finite set such that, for every $k\leq\operatorname{dim} V$, every $k$-dimensional subset of $V$ has at most $2^k$ elements.

**Log-span conjecture.**

$$
\beta(V)=|V|,
$$

and in particular

$$
\alpha(V)\geq |V|^{1/2}.
$$

This conjecture would follow from the linear matroid conjecture together with the theorem for subsets of quasicubes; it extends the sharp tripling bound known for quasicubes to a broader class of sets.
source_name: Dávid Matolcsi, Imre Ruzsa, George Shakan and Dmitrii Zhelezov, “An analytic approach to cardinalities of sumsets”, arXiv:2003.04075 (2020).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.04075

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2020).
